subject: Vendor activation: tax docs & PO readiness for Lighthouse AI
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Quinn <oliver.quinn@lighthouse-ai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-14 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding: Tax docs & PO readiness for Lighthouse AI

Hi Oliver —

Thanks for choosing Redwood. We're kicking off vendor activation so Payments can schedule the first invoice. To get Lighthouse AI fully active we need the following items from your side:

- Completed tax form: W-9 (US entity) OR W-8BEN-E (if non-US).
- Signed PO (we've sent a DocuSign envelope for PO #45123) — please return the executed copy.
- Bank remittance details (account, routing/SWIFT, beneficiary name) for ACH/wire setup.
- VAT certificate if you have EU operations (only needed if invoices include VAT).

I've attached our Vendor Intake Form to capture missing fields; please return that with the tax form. If you expect any changes to legal entity name or remit address, flag that now so we can make the PO match.

Target timeline: getting everything by EOD Tue 2/16 would allow us to set up vendor record and pay the first invoice on 3/1. Let me know if that works.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Vendor Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf
From: Oliver Quinn <oliver.quinn@lighthouse-ai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-14 13:50:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Tax docs & PO readiness for Lighthouse AI

Hi Mina —

Thanks for the checklist. Attached is our completed W-9 and the filled vendor intake form. Legal name on the W-9 is 'Lighthouse AI, Inc.' which should match the PO.

I'll route the DocuSign PO to our finance lead and send back signed PO and bank remittance details shortly. Net30 is our standard, but open to discussing early-pay discounts if Redwood offers them.

Best,
Oliver Quinn
Head of Finance Operations
Lighthouse AI
oliver.quinn@lighthouse-ai.com

Attachments: Lighthouse_W-9_2027.pdf; Vendor_Intake_Form_Filled.pdf
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Quinn <oliver.quinn@lighthouse-ai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-15 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Tax docs & PO readiness for Lighthouse AI

Appreciate the quick turn, Oliver. A couple of clarifications:

- Legal entity name 'Lighthouse AI, Inc.' is perfect — we'll ensure PO line items use that exact name.
- Please return the executed PO via DocuSign link so our Contracts and Payments teams have a signed copy for the vendor file. DocuSign envelope is PO-45123: https://app.docusign.com/Signing/?t=PO-45123
- For bank remittance, we need routing number + account number and whether you prefer ACH or wire. If you're international, include SWIFT and intermediary bank details.
- If Lighthouse AI will ever invoice us from an EU entity and charge VAT, we'll need a VAT certificate (or a signed statement that VAT is not charged).

HubSpot company record (for reference): https://hubspot.com/contacts/companies/LA-98765

Goal: once we have the signed PO + bank info, Payments will provision Lighthouse AI in our AP system and schedule the first payment run.

Thanks,
Mina
From: Oliver Quinn <oliver.quinn@lighthouse-ai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts@lighthouse-ai.com
Date: 2027-02-16 16:20:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Tax docs & PO readiness for Lighthouse AI

Mina —

Attached: signed PO (PO_45123_signed.pdf) and our bank remittance instructions. VAT certificate is attached as well — Lighthouse AI currently does not charge VAT on US invoices but we've provided the EU VAT cert for your records.

Bank details (summary):
- Bank: First Pacific Bank
- ABA: 024000024
- Account: 1122334455
- SWIFT: FPACUS33
- Beneficiary: Lighthouse AI, Inc.

We are OK with Net30. Please confirm that Redwood can process payment starting the March cycle.

Oliver

Attachments: Signed_PO_45123.pdf; Bank_Remittance_Instructions.pdf; VAT_Certificate_2027.pdf

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: Tax docs & PO readiness for Lighthouse AI

Thanks Oliver — bank details and signed PO received. Quick notes from Finance:

- We'll record Lighthouse AI, Inc. under tax ID 12-3456789 as provided on the W-9. Please confirm that tax ID is correct.
- Net30 approved; first payment scheduled for March 1st run, assuming invoice arrives in time and coding is correct.
- We have a standard vendor setup checklist; once Marissa completes vendor record in AP, you'll get a system email with vendor ID.

Mina/Marissa — can you confirm outstanding items and close the loop?

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Manager, Payments Operations
Redwood Inference

Oliver —

Confirmed: vendor record created (Vendor ID RED-98765). W-9, signed PO, bank remit and VAT cert have been attached to the vendor file in the AP system. Lighthouse AI is set to be paid on the March 1 payment run (Net30).

Closing the onboarding checklist — if anything else pops up we'll reopen, otherwise welcome aboard.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
